homework.subject: Mathematics
homework.chapter: Chapter 2: Linear Equations in One Variable
homework.topic: Solving Equations with Variables on Both Sides
homework.teachingSummary: Aaj class mein humne variables on both sides wali linear equations ko solve karna seekha. Transposition method aur LCM method se fractions simplify kiye. Blackboard par 4 board level questions step-by-step solve karwaye.
homework.instructions:
1. NCERT Exercise 2.3 ke Question 1 se 10 complete karein.
2. Blackboard par note kiye gaye 2 special questions solve karke copy ki photo upload karein.
3. Fair homework copy me step-by-step calculations dikhayein.

homework.subject: Mathematics
homework.teachingSummary: Aaj class mein humne Quadratic Equations ka standard form ax² + bx + c = 0 revise kiya aur Discriminant D = b² - 4ac calculate karna seekha. Real & distinct roots (D > 0), Equal roots (D = 0), aur No real roots (D < 0) ke concepts with 5 board exam questions solve kiye.
homework.instructions:
1. Solve Exercise 4.3 Questions 1 to 6 in your fair homework notebook.
2. Clearly show calculation of Discriminant D for every question.
3. Attempt the HOTS question attached in the worksheet.
4. Take clear, well-lit photos and upload before the tomorrow morning deadline.

homework.subject: Science (Physics)
homework.teachingSummary: Aaj class mein concave mirror and convex mirror ke sign conventions (New Cartesian Sign Convention) cover kiye. Mirror formula 1/f = 1/v + 1/u aur magnification formula m = -v/u = h'/h derive kiye and 3 board exam numericals solve kiye.
homework.instructions: Solve the 4 numericals given in page 171 of NCERT. Remember to write proper given data, formula, and units in answers.

homework.subject: Mathematics
homework.teachingSummary: Aaj class mein Remainder Theorem aur Factor Theorem ka practical difference explain kiya gaya. Cubic polynomials ko middle term splitting and factor theorem se factorize karna sikhaya.
homework.instructions: Complete Exercise 2.4 Q3, Q4, and Q5 all sub-parts. Write step-by-step factorization.

faqs.q: How does daily homework submission and checking work?
faqs.a: After every physical lecture, the teacher publishes daily key concepts. Students solve the practice problems in their notebooks, upload photos or PDFs directly through their student login, and receive verified marks and corrections before the next day's lecture.

faqs.q: Which classes and subjects are covered?
faqs.a: We provide comprehensive coaching for Mathematics, Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), English, and Hindi for Classes 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 across CBSE, ICSE, and State Boards.

faqs.q: How can parents and students track fee payments and attendance?
faqs.a: The portal automatically tracks attendance daily and provides computer-generated fee receipts, active membership validity dates, and advance renewal reminders with zero manual calculation errors.

faqs.q: How can I contact for admissions or offline classroom visits?
faqs.a: You can reach out directly to AIHSAN ANSARI via phone or WhatsApp at +91 99058 47357 for trial class bookings, batch schedules, and fee details.

faqs.q: Who provides login credentials for students and teachers?
faqs.a: All logins are generated and managed strictly by the Institute Owner through the administrative cabin to ensure authorized, secure access.
